title: Quests: what each person says when they ask for help
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: "My brother Tam went down the stair with the first expedition. Everyone says he's dead. He promised he'd scratch our sign on a wall if he got past the goblins -- a little fox. Will you look for it?"

"The Ironroot smelters need heat to work the slag. Find me three coils of heating wire and a block of star-iron from the Fallen Star Mine, and I'll get the fires roaring again before winter freezes us all in place."
The Nest's forge burns on a firebird's breath. Only a grandmaster may work it. Make eight pieces at the grandmaster's pace and one Masterwork from the deep's own metal, and the flame is yours to use.

"The Archive's index keys are lost, Elder Bai said. But the Hollow Moon hangs wrong over Eliet now. Someone in the Deep Frozen Archive stole a key and broke the seal. Find me one ice-sealed codex key to start.
"My brother Tam went down the stair with the first expedition. Everyone says he's dead. He promised he'd scratch our sign on a wall if he got past the goblins -- a little fox. Will you look for it?"

"Elder Mo has kept our house for forty years and never looked at the sky. He says the stars are a lie told by the Deep. Bring me proof from the High Observatory on Floor 12 that he was wrong, or I will pack his things himself."

"My brother Tam went down the stair with the first expedition forty years ago. He promised to leave a little fox mark on a wall if he survived the goblins. I'd just like to find that scratch, even if it's just his name in the dust."

"The valley's first expedition went down forty years ago. Nine people reached the stairs, but only one came back to speak. Captain Rhee says that survivor is still in the Lodge, telling stories no one remembers. Find him, and ask why he stayed behind while his friends died."

"The tortoise sleeps in Shellhaven, but his shell rattles when the deep wakes. I carry a bell to quiet it. Bring me the brass clapper from Floor 40, and we'll make him sleep again."

The goblin sign Tam scratched is faint, half-swallowed by moss and a small fox's claw-mark. Find the fox at Floor 12 near the rusted gate where the first expedition stopped. Bring it to Little Rin in Eliet.

Captain Rhee says the Lodge books are full of ink that won't wash out. Bring me three pages torn from the warrens' logs, and I'll write down what your brother really found before we send him up the stair.

"The deep's metal changes when it touches the sky. Bring me ore from the Fallen Star Mine, then fold it with the air from the Thunderhead Spire. Make a blade that sings in the wind, and I'll teach you the secret of star-steel.

"My brother Tam went down the stair with the first expedition forty years ago, and everyone says he's dead. He promised to scratch our sign on a wall before those goblins with little foxes get him. Will you look for it?"

"The echo in the Drowned Palace isn't a sound; it's a memory trapped in the water. Find three stones that still hum the old songs. Place them in the basin, and the water will stop weeping for its dead."
"My brother Tam went down the stair with the first expedition. Everyone says he's dead. He promised he'd scratch our sign on a wall if he got past the goblins -- a little fox. Will you look for it?"

"The tortoise sleeps beneath Eliet, and his shell hums with the heat of sleeping cities. A traveler once left a carving on the outer ridge, half-swallowed by moss. Find where his skin meets the stone, and tell me if he dreams.
"The deep gives us star iron that sings when cooled. Old Marn found the seam, but he's gone now. Bring me a block of his ore, and I'll beat the song back into a blade before it fades."

"You want to swing a sword, you ought to know what's in one. Grind me three whetstones and beat out an iron sword. Not a good one. Just one that holds."

Don't climb the center shaft on Floor 25 where the Mirror waits—it shows you a ghost of your own death. If you see red dust, turn back before it chokes your nanites. Keep moving.
"Smith Hale's hammer has a head made of dragon bone. He says it hums when the deep is restless. Bring me a shard of star iron from the Fallen Seam, and I'll forge you a hammer that sings back.
